proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704, what is the maximum projection beyond an exterior wall, expressed as a fraction of the distance from the assumed vertical plane (where opening protection first becomes required) to the property line?
proposed.rationale: Section 704 limits projections beyond the exterior wall to a maximum of one-third of the distance from the assumed vertical plane where opening protection first becomes required to the property line. The distance is measured at right angles from the property line.
proposed.explanation: Measurement direction matters: do not measure diagonally or along the wall. The right-angle (perpendicular) measurement governs for fire-separation and setback distances.
